issues.description: The UML in the problem statement declares getTotalNumberOfStudents() as public (plus-sign in class diagram), but the solution implementation declares this method with protected visibility. This inconsistency between the stated API in the problem description and the solution's access modifier can confuse students about the intended visibility and API contract.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the visibility consistent. Either change the solution implementation of getTotalNumberOfStudents() to public (preferred to match the UML/provided specification) or update the problem statement/UML to indicate protected visibility. Also clarify the intended visibility in the template TODO to avoid student confusion.
